question: Does a yogi who falls from yoga suffer destruction in either world?
premises: no destruction exists for him here or there
doer of good never goes to bad course
faith is not lost so destruction is absent
inference: Krishna assures that a fallen yogi is not destroyed in either world.
plain_english: Krishna says there is no destruction for such a person in this world or the next, because a doer of good never goes to a bad course and faith is not lost.
